title: Nanobiocatalytic upgrading of heavy oil using Geobacillus stearothermophilus and alumina nanoparticles
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7022-7039
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07786A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ali Maghzi, Arezou Jafari, Seyyed Mohammad Mousavi, Riyaz Kharrat
We undertook the analyses to demonstrate the simultaneous application of Geobacillus stearothermophilus and nano alumina in heavy oil upgrading. It could be applied to environmental and technical industrial applications.
